annotations.title: Get Item Details and Reported Trades

description:
Read Jagex guide-price records, catalogue metadata and item Wiki links. Use lookup_item to discover IDs, compare_item_prices for daily snapshots, get_price_series for raw history, or summarize_price_history for statistics.

Choose exactly one selector:
- itemId: one integer GE ID, e.g. 4151; bypasses name resolution.
- name: one item name, e.g. "Abyssal whip"; ambiguity returns candidates instead of choosing.
- itemIds: a unique integer array, e.g. [4151,536]; returns ordered batch rows even for one ID. Do not mix selectors or use monster IDs.

Set includeLiveData=true when you need recorded instant-buy/instant-sell sides or buy-limit/alchemy facts. These enrichments preserve the guide fields; trade sides are not executable offers, and a buy limit is not remaining account quota.

- Invalid batches fail before fetching; unavailable IDs fail per row. All-failed batches error.
- At most two reads run concurrently. A 429 halts queued IDs; honor Retry-After.
- Guide records are uncached and lag market activity. Trades cache 30 seconds; numeric mapping caches 10 minutes. Hits retain fetchedAt.
- No credentials are required. HTTP defaults to 60 requests/IP/minute.

includeLiveData.description: Add RS3 API v2 last-reported trade high/low prices and numeric buy-limit/alchemy facts; preserves Jagex guide-price fields

itemId.description: Grand Exchange item ID (provide itemId or name)

name.description: Item name (provide itemId or name). Prefer lookup_item for fuzzy search.
